why: Each new structural option fixes one family of regions and pushes another the wrong way, often one held right by an older compensating setting: e49 fixes Iran's summer (0.937 -> 0.538 at 0.02) but Central Asia and the Levant then run hot in summer (the training group's temperature +1.8 %); e50 fixes the eastern Mediterranean's winter (Anatolia 0.408 -> 0.320, Levant 0.407 -> 0.362) but warms eastern and western Europe's winters (mid-latitude group ~+1.6 %); the crest wind restores the relief response (0.03 -> 0.41) but floods dry basins. This search lets them rebalance together with the settings they push against (sub-grid lift, lee drying, dry-ground coupling, eddy exchange, recycling, slope lift).

afterwards: The best candidate takes the unchanged gate (policy_v2) against a fresh r37 reference under the then source fingerprint, the paired 28 km check and the sealed six once (the six were seen once at r37: their north-east US result informs nothing here); scripts/city_rain.py is reported alongside.
